metadata.summary: England and Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham can become one of the world's greatest ever players, according to Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane.
metadata.content: Jude Bellingham: England and Real Madrid star tipped for greatness after Croatia thrashing by Roy Keane | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Jude Bellingham: England and Real Madrid star tipped for greatness after Croatia thrashing by Roy Keane England inflicted Croatia's biggest defeat in a 7-0 hammering in the Nations League with Jude Bellingham scoring one goal and setting up three more in a complete performance from the Real Madrid star who continues to shine for the Three Lions after his World Cup heroics Saturday 3 October 2026 20:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Thomas Tuchel praised England's 'dangerous' front four after the thrashing of Croatia England and Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham can become one of the world's greatest ever players, according to Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane. The 23-year-old scored one goal and set up three more as England inflicted Croatia's biggest defeat in a 7-0 hammering in front of a reduced crowd in Rijeka in the Nations League. Bellingham was England's standout player at the World Cup and has become the focal point of Thomas Tuchel's side, registering 13 goal involvements in his last 11 games since the start of the tournament. messages.text: Caballo De Mar upsets Scandinavia in Cadran clash

metadata.summary: Caballo De Mar brought an end to Scandinavia’s eight-race winning run when repeating his win in the Qatar Prix du Cadran from 12 months ago in a thrilling finish at ParisLongchamp.
metadata.content: ParisLongchamp: Caballo De Mar upsets Scandinavia in Prix du Cadran | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content ParisLongchamp: Caballo De Mar upsets Scandinavia in Prix du Cadran After surviving a lengthy stewards' enquiry, Caballo De Mar retained his Prix du Cadran crown, defeating red-hot favourite Scandinavia in a thrilling renewal of the Group 1 staying contest at ParisLongchamp. Saturday 3 October 2026 17:07, UK Image: Caballo De Mar - back-to-back winner of the Prix du Cadran Caballo De Mar brought an end to Scandinavia’s eight-race winning run when repeating his win in the Qatar Prix du Cadran from 12 months ago in a thrilling finish at ParisLongchamp. George Scott's stayer was delivered by Oisin Murphy at the furlong marker to grab the lead from Scandinavia and the fading pacesetter Queenstown. As the pair locked horns through the final furlong, Scandinavia regained the lead only for Caballo De Mar to fight back in the shadow of the post to get up by a neck. Connections had to sweat through a stewards' inquiry after an objection by Ryan Moore, whose mount Scandinavia, the 1-6 favourite, appeared to receive a bump from the 9-2 winner close to the finish. Rybakina reached the top of the world rankings after winning the US Open last month - her second Grand Slam title of 2026 - but was brought crashing back down to earth with a 6-3 4-6 3-6 defeat to Alina Charaeva at the China Open on Saturday afternoon. Armenia's Charaeva had never faced a top-20 player before this match, but stunned the top seed to set up a round-of-32 clash with Britain's Sonay Kartal.
